*SUBSCRIBE to Film Theory!*
Don't miss a Film Theory! ► https://www.youtube.com/@FilmTheory/?sub_confirmation=1

When you were a kid, do you remember watching Shazam? No you don’t! Many of us actually have fake memories of movies that NEVER existed, just like Shazam and Eggs in Space. What is YOUR Mandela Movie?
